name: Primary Exit
source:
The end of my shift should have been simple, but the building had other plans. Locked in and alone, the once-familiar office had become a maze, and I was its unwilling guest.

[From [url=https://y-ingfoxy.itch.io/primary-exit]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我的轮班结束应该很简单，但大楼有其他计划。曾经熟悉的办公室被锁在里面，独自一人，变成了一个迷宫，而我是它不情愿的客人。

[来自[url=https://y-ingfoxy.itch.io/primary-exit]Itch.io[/url]]
